name: fk-payroll-social
description: Run ordinary Falkland Islands payroll withholding and Retirement Pension Contributions for 2026, with self-employed contribution coverage. Use for POAT, RPC, Medical Services Tax, new employee notification, EMP-02, E-POAT, monthly payment, certificates and employer year-end questions. Distinguishes resident main employment from secondary and non-resident employment and uses the official weekly or monthly payroll tables rather than simply dividing annual income tax. Includes pension earnings thresholds, multiple jobs, resident and overseas voluntary contributions and late-payment boundaries. Defence-related exemptions, unusual benefits, agency status and special pensions require the specific official determination rather than an assumed exemption.
